label: Conditional likelihood of an incoming-list prefix after another prefix
definition: Divide the finite-class prior mass of sourced worlds that match both the new and the observed prefix records by the prior mass of sourced worlds matching the observed prefix.
note: Interpret as a conditional likelihood only with a proper distribution and positive observed mass. Both records refer to the same traced recipient, order, population and supplier lists. Selecting already-known matching prefixes can change the comparison and must be reflected in the conditioning.
